title: finding(components): an `element:number` with neither `object` nor a `dataSource` binding now passes the html tier and paints an empty dash silently: PR objectui#10944 relaxed `object`'s `required`, so no JSX gate reports the missing object
body:
Filing-gate category: ① an authoring error that no longer reaches any authoring-time gate, with a named landing site. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`, as the follow-up contract review `5867599385` on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10944 (objectui#10909) names. That PR disclosed the trade in its changeset (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## What changed
- To accept the spec's `dataSource` form, PR objectui#10944 registers `element:number` through `elementDataSourceBlock`: the manifest declares `dataSource`, and `object` is no longer `required`.
- Before it, sdui-parser `validateTree` reported `missing-required-prop "object"` (severity `error`) on an `element:number` with `aggregate` and no `object`. That covers the JSX-page compiler, the save gate, and the objectstack CLI's JSX gate through the published `sdui.manifest.json`.
- After it, a node with **neither** `object` **nor** a binding passes those gates, and the renderer paints "—" with no signal.
  - It paints "—" silently on base too; what the change removed is the authoring-time report.
- Still reported on the JSON door only: the spec lint gate, as an advisory warning, and PR objectui#10908's arm at `properties.object` once it lands, and then only when a bag is present.

## Precedent
objectui#10508 made the same trade on calendar and gantt `objectName`.

## Direction (for triage to grade)
Pick one, measured:
- **(a) a runtime notice:** `ElementNumberRenderer` renders an explicit "no object named" state (not the empty dash) when the resolved object is absent and an `aggregate` is set;
- **(b) a one-of check at the html tier:** the manifest input model expresses "`object` or `dataSource.object`" and `validateTree` reports when neither is present.

(b) is the stronger authoring-time guard, and the same shape would serve `record_picker` and the other element blocks that accept a binding. Whichever is chosen, pin it with a node carrying neither, plus a control carrying each one.

## Dedupe
A semantic search of objectui issues (`element:number`, neither object nor dataSource, empty dash, `missing-required-prop`, one-of) returned nothing.
